subject: general
question: Six persons are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. Alok sits to the immediate right of Sonu. Ladoo sits third to the left of Alok. Soni sits third to the right of Sonu. Dimple is an immediate neighbour of both Ladoo and Sonu. Sushma is not an immediate neighbour of Ladoo. Who sits second to the right of Sushma?
solution:
Given: Six persons are sitting around a circular table facing the centre.

1) Alok sits to the immediate right of Sonu.

2) Ladoo sits third to the left of Alok.

3) Dimple is an immediate neighbour of both Ladoo and Sonu.

4) Soni sits third to the right of Sonu.

5) Sushma is not an immediate neighbour of Ladoo.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/923beabf7f7863ae1afbeaaca9ae9781d18247600e6c016aca5c1ad165d055bf.png] 

So, 'Ladoo' sits second to the right of Sushma.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3"**.
